2026-ALCA.mechanism_zh: 红外图里的小亮点容易跟纹理混在一起，通道均值也看不出尖峰。ALCA 将各通道的均值、峰值和标准差交错排列，再用分组卷积计算通道门。
2026-ALCA.mechanism_en: ALCA measures the mean, maximum, and standard deviation of each infrared feature channel. It interleaves those statistics by channel and uses grouped convolutions to turn them into channel weights.

2026-BSGA.mechanism_zh: 多视图重建里，多数图块之间没有几何对应。BSGA 先池化查询和键来估计块间匹配度，再只对得分高的块计算细粒度注意力。
2026-BSGA.mechanism_en: BSGA uses pooled queries and keys to find promising blocks of cross-view patch matches. Those blocks receive full attention, while most patch pairs are skipped during 3D reconstruction.

2026-CANA.mechanism_zh: 重复纹理常落在两个窗口，普通窗口注意力看不到彼此。CANA 用池化后的窗口特征给图块聚类，各簇再读取相邻簇里匹配同一窗口的键和值。
2026-CANA.mechanism_en: CANA groups patches by affinity to pooled window features, bringing similar textures together across window boundaries. Attention can also read matching keys and values from neighboring clusters.

2026-CKDA.mechanism_zh: Delta Rule 做一次低秩更新难以表达二维旋转。CKDA 放宽门和更新系数的取值，让逐通道门能取负，提供合成旋转所需的另一次反射。
2026-CKDA.mechanism_en: CKDA lets channel gates take negative values and widens the delta-rule coefficient range. The gate can supply a reflection, which combines with one delta-rule update to represent a two-dimensional rotation.
2026-CKDA.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The maximum absolute difference between the independent real-valued signed recurrence and the ported naive_recurrent output was 3.58e-07.

2026-CWA.mechanism_zh: 体积小的结构容易在分割时被大块组织掩盖。CWA 把编码器和解码器的特征拼接，经卷积和 softmax 得到互补权重，再用 SE 筛选融合后的通道。
2026-CWA.mechanism_en: CWA learns a voxelwise balance between encoder detail and decoder context. A convolution and softmax produce complementary weights, and an SE block refines the channels after fusion.

2026-Clipped-RoPE.mechanism_zh: RoPE 的低频分量在长文里会带来训练时没见过的变化。CoPE 软裁剪这些分量，限制它们的影响，同时避免硬裁剪带来的频谱泄漏。
2026-Clipped-RoPE.mechanism_en: CoPE soft-clips the low-frequency components of rotary position encoding. It limits their contribution over long contexts while avoiding the spectral leakage associated with a hard cutoff.
2026-Clipped-RoPE.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed by directly importing the official class from the pinned commit. The checks covered default frequencies, dynamic expansion, and contraction. The maximum absolute difference was 0.

2026-CyFA.mechanism_zh: 循环层把所有旧关联挤进同一状态，读久了容易串。CyFA 用可学习的时钟一起转动键和值的记忆槽，再把当前键值写进最新的槽。
2026-CyFA.mechanism_en: CyFA organizes recurrent memory by the relative age of its contents. A learned clock circulates the key and value states together, and each new association enters the youngest slot.
2026-CyFA.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The CPU version also compared cached outputs for the full input and for input split into segments of 7, 1, and 8 tokens. The maximum absolute difference was 4.7683716e-7.

2026-DCSA.mechanism_zh: 高光谱图里，许多波段彼此重复。DCSA 先算通道两两的相关分数，再从当前图像估计该保留多少个，只让各行的高分项参与混合。
2026-DCSA.mechanism_en: DCSA scores interactions between spectral channels, then uses the input to decide how many scores to keep in each row. The strongest links guide super-resolution without weighting every redundant channel pair.

2026-DMA.mechanism_zh: 高光谱图块要分的是中心像素，周围像素只提供线索。DMA 用中心像素查询空间邻域，用双向衰减给邻近波段更多权重，再把两路特征逐元素相乘。
2026-DMA.mechanism_en: DMA puts the center pixel in charge of spatial attention. A separate path favors nearby spectral bands with bidirectional decay, and elementwise multiplication brings the spatial and spectral responses together.

2026-DWSA.mechanism_zh: 相似图块的平均值能去掉些噪声，却容易磨掉块里的纹理。DWSA 一路在窗口中加权汇总图块，另一路估计块内的二阶相关性，给去噪补上像素关系。
2026-DWSA.mechanism_en: A weighted average of similar patches can wash out detail within a patch. DWSA pairs windowed patch aggregation with a second branch that estimates within-patch covariance for denoising.

2026-FlashAttention-4.mechanism_zh: 在 Blackwell 上，矩阵乘法跑得快了，softmax 和搬数据更容易拖慢注意力。FlashAttention-4 用更大的计算块重叠搬运与乘法，并只在需要时重缩放 softmax。
2026-FlashAttention-4.mechanism_en: FlashAttention-4 keeps standard softmax attention but changes how it runs on Blackwell. Larger tiles overlap asynchronous matrix operations with data movement, and conditional rescaling cuts work outside the matrix products.

2026-Gated-KalmaNet.mechanism_zh: 固定衰减的递推状态常忘掉早先的线索。Gated KalmaNet 保留误差协方差来计算 Kalman 增益，把状态更新写成在线岭回归，再用输入门控制正则强度。
2026-Gated-KalmaNet.mechanism_en: Gated KalmaNet uses covariance to decide how much a new key-value pair should change memory. Its update takes the form of online ridge regression, with an input-dependent gate regulating the regularization.

2026-HAE.mechanism_zh: 医学图像里的细边界和大片结构需要不同尺度的线索。HAE 把通道分两路，一路提取多尺度卷积特征，另一路用池化结果先调通道再调位置。
2026-HAE.mechanism_en: HAE splits the channels between multiscale convolution and a gated path. The gated path pools features to generate channel weights first and spatial weights second, helping preserve anatomy across resolutions.

2026-HiLS-Attention.mechanism_zh: 长文按块挑选注意力时，挑错块就读不到需要的词。HiLS 先用块的地标键做检索，对每个入选块独立归一化，再按检索分数混合读出。
2026-HiLS-Attention.mechanism_en: HiLS gives each chunk a landmark for retrieval. A query attends separately inside the chunks it finds and mixes their readouts by retrieval score, so language-model training can teach it which chunks to select.

2026-Kalman-Linear-Attention.mechanism_zh: 线性递推更新状态时，对已经记住的内容有多确定也很重要。Kalman Linear Attention 连同状态的不确定性一起更新，把信息形式的滤波写成并行扫描。
2026-Kalman-Linear-Attention.mechanism_en: Kalman Linear Attention tracks both a state estimate and its uncertainty. Writing the Kalman update in information form allows the model to scan many time steps in parallel, even though each recurrent update is nonlinear.
2026-Kalman-Linear-Attention.check_en: The comparison used the same state_dict with strict loading and the same random input. The maximum absolute difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-LP.mechanism_zh: 只修高频细节，会漏掉图像的低频轮廓。AIRPNet 的 LP 块给小波低频分量生成注意力图，和卷积主路的特征拼起来，一起恢复轮廓。
2026-LP.mechanism_en: The low-frequency band still holds much of an image's structure. AIRPNet's LP block generates an attention map for that band and concatenates it with trunk features for restoration.

2026-MCA.mechanism_zh: 手机校色要辨认颜色通道之间的关系，逐像素配对却很贵。MCA 用压缩的锚点连接查询和键，在通道间算两张权重图，再用它们混合受光照调节的值。
2026-MCA.mechanism_en: MCA uses compressed anchors to connect queries and keys across color channels. It applies the two attention maps to illumination-modulated values, so color correction can respond to the lighting without full spatial attention.

2026-MSA.mechanism_zh: 分组查询里，各组有时要回看不同段落。MiniMax Sparse Attention 用轻量索引器给每组的键值块打分，主支路只对该组挑出的块算完整注意力。
2026-MSA.mechanism_en: MiniMax Sparse Attention gives each grouped-query group its own shortlist of cache blocks. A lightweight index branch ranks the blocks, and the main branch computes exact attention over the selected ones.
2026-MSA.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The maximum absolute difference was 3.58e-07.

2026-MVP-VLM.mechanism_zh: 只用一种规则裁图块，容易删掉别的规则会看重的细节。MVP 用多种裁剪方法监督一个双注意力模块，让它预测各视觉词元该保留多少权重。
2026-MVP-VLM.mechanism_en: A visual token can matter for more than one reason. MVP trains a small dual-attention pruner on several complementary pruning signals, giving it a soft importance score for each visual token.

2026-MoM.mechanism_zh: 线性注意力把过去都压进一份状态，不相干的记忆容易互相干扰。MoM 改用多份独立状态，由路由器为当前词元选择要更新和读取的记忆。
2026-MoM.mechanism_en: Mixture-of-Memories routes tokens among several independent recurrent states. Separating the memories reduces interference while each state still uses a linear-time update.
2026-MoM.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. Tokens were collected per memory and the FLA reference recurrence was used to check inputs with and without padding. The maximum absolute difference for the outputs was 9.31e-09.

2026-PAT-ch.mechanism_zh: 有些特征通道很相似，每个通道都算注意力会重复。PAT-ch 把特征分组，只在一部分通道上用均值和方差生成通道门，另一部分走卷积。
2026-PAT-ch.mechanism_en: PAT-ch applies Gaussian-style channel attention to only part of a feature map, using each channel's mean and variance to form its gate. A convolution processes a separate subset of channels.

2026-PSAA.mechanism_zh: 红外图里，小亮点和背景接近，全图注意力容易漏掉细微变化。PSAA 一路用低频结构和像素能量算权重，另一路用小波看细节，合并后再给通道加权。
2026-PSAA.mechanism_en: PSAA pairs a global branch that scores features using low-frequency structure and pixel energy with a wavelet branch for local detail. Channel gates refine the combined response.

2026-PoM.mechanism_zh: 长序列两两打分开销很大。PoM 用学到的多项式把词元汇成一份紧凑摘要，每个词元再从这份摘要读取自己的上下文。
2026-PoM.mechanism_en: PoM learns a polynomial summary of the input sequence and lets each token retrieve information from that common summary. The work grows linearly with the number of tokens.

2026-RSWAttention.mechanism_zh: 辨认生成图像要看局部痕迹，全图注意力容易把这些细节冲淡。RSWAttention 把各频带的邻近特征拼到同一滑动窗口内，再比较窗口里的位置。
2026-RSWAttention.mechanism_en: RSWAttention assembles nearby features from different frequency bands into each sliding window. Attention stays within that window, where it can compare local patterns that help identify a generated image.

2026-SAA.mechanism_zh: 超分辨率要靠远处纹理补细节，普通窗口只能看近处。SAA 按密度和孤立程度找代表图块，合并键和值，原分辨率的查询仍能读全图。
2026-SAA.mechanism_en: SAA keeps a query at every image position but replaces groups of keys and values with representative tokens. Density and isolation help choose those representatives so the global read can still retain fine detail.

2026-SCA-LRDUN.mechanism_zh: 恢复压缩的高光谱图像时，低秩表示也要看清较远的边缘和纹理。SCA 在空间子空间特征上用大感受野卷积汇集邻域，再按内容调节特征。
2026-SCA-LRDUN.mechanism_en: SCA refines the spatial subspace used to reconstruct a hyperspectral image. Wide convolutional neighborhoods supply contextual cues for feature weighting without a dense spatial attention matrix.

2026-SDGW.mechanism_zh: 电镜曝光短，图上的原子位置容易被噪声盖住。SDGW 用各位置附近的标准差算权重，决定那里该多用哪一种卷积响应。
2026-SDGW.mechanism_en: Short electron-microscope exposures leave noisy images. SDGW uses local standard deviation to weight different convolution responses at each position, allowing the denoiser to vary by location.

2026-SGA.mechanism_zh: 两期图像里，真实变化有时藏在相似的背景里。SGA 从两张特征图的空间位置算混合均值和联合方差，用它们构造高斯核来给差异加权。
2026-SGA.mechanism_en: SGA looks for changes between images of the same scene at two times. It builds a spatial Gaussian kernel from their mixed mean and joint variance to expose differences that simpler fusion can miss.

2026-SSLA.mechanism_zh: 事件相机每次多半只在少数位置有新信号，整份状态都改一遍很浪费。SSLA 把线性注意力状态分成空间小组，每个事件只更新和读取相关的组。
2026-SSLA.mechanism_en: An event camera reports sparse changes, so each event need not update a dense memory. SSLA partitions linear attention into spatial states and activates only the states selected for that event.

2026-TAM.mechanism_zh: 逐帧分割心脏会丢掉运动信息，另做图像配准又容易传入误差。TAM 让不同帧的特征做多头交叉注意力，再用门控调节每对帧传递多少信息。
2026-TAM.mechanism_en: TAM lets cardiac frames exchange motion cues through multihead cross-attention. Gates control the contribution from each frame pair, allowing a segmentation model to use temporal context without a separate registration step.

2026-VMonarch.mechanism_zh: 视频扩散的注意力很大，但时空分数常有稀疏结构。VMonarch 交替更新结构化矩阵的因子，近似帧内和帧间注意力，再对不稳定的位置重算。
2026-VMonarch.mechanism_en: VMonarch fits structured Monarch factors to a video model's attention, with separate structure for within-frame and across-frame relationships. It recomputes selected positions when the approximation is unstable.
2026-VMonarch.check_en: The maximum absolute difference threshold for the CPU forward pass was 1e-5. Alternating updates of 1, 2, and 3 iterations were paired with exact recomputation for 0 or 16 tokens. The maximum absolute differences for all six sets of outputs were 0.

2026-ViT3-TTT.mechanism_zh: 图像词元一多，自注意力的两两打分就很贵。ViT3 在前向时用键重建值来训练一个小模型，再把查询交给这个模型读出信息。
2026-ViT3-TTT.mechanism_en: ViT3 turns attention into a small learning problem inside the forward pass. An inner model learns to predict values from keys and then evaluates the queries, avoiding a full table of token-pair scores.
2026-ViT3-TTT.check_en: The maximum absolute difference threshold for the CPU forward pass was 1e-5. The maximum absolute difference was 0.

na-DiffAttn.mechanism_zh: 普通注意力会给无关上下文分去一些权重。DiffAttn 算两张 softmax 注意力图，用第一张减去按可学习系数缩放的第二张，压低重复响应。
na-DiffAttn.mechanism_en: Differential attention subtracts a learned multiple of one softmax attention map from another. The subtraction suppresses shared responses that would otherwise distract from the relevant context.

na-LSKA.mechanism_zh: 大二维卷积核很吃算力。LSKA 把深度卷积拆成先横后竖的一维卷积，再把算出的空间权重乘回特征图。
na-LSKA.mechanism_en: LSKA builds a wide spatial gate with horizontal and vertical one-dimensional depthwise filters. The factorization lets a convolutional network use a much wider receptive field without the cost of a large square kernel.
